tasks.title: Word ribbon to OnlyOffice single-row layout (toolbar 86px -> 112px)
tasks.acceptance_prose:
ONLYOFFICE REFERENCE (measured 2026-10-05 from the live OO rig, viewport 1440, dsf 1): OO #toolbar is 112px = a 28px tab-strip row + one ~84px control row of 46px-tall controls.

WO CURRENT STATE (the deployed vanilla editor apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg): .toolbar height: 86px (style.css ~line 128); the Home tab is HARDCODED two-row in index.html ~line 205: <div class="ribbon-page two-row active" data-tab="home"> holding two .ribbon-row divs (Row A: undo/redo + font selects + paragraph/lists; Row B: character styles + alignment); .toolbar button height: 32px; tabs live in .menu-bar above the toolbar.

GOAL: make the WO Word ribbon match OnlyOffice's single-row proportions so the ribbon-chrome pixel gate converges (baseline diff 8.0%):
1. Home tab becomes single-row: remove the 'two-row' class from the home ribbon-page so it renders through the existing single-row path (.ribbon-page.active:not(.two-row) = flex nowrap). MERGE both rows' controls into that single row WITHOUT dropping or hiding any button/select/menu/control. If they no longer fit on one line, it is acceptable for the row to wrap, but every control must remain present and clickable.
2. Toolbar height: change .toolbar height to ~112px (accept gate: >=108px and <=120px) so the band occupies OO's 112px.
3. Controls: raise .toolbar button height from 32px toward ~46px so the single row fills the band; keep widths/padding sane so no two controls collide and every id stays unique.
4. Tabs may stay in .menu-bar or move into the toolbar top as a 28px strip - your call, the pixel gate judges. Keep the same tab labels, ids, active-state behavior, and the 3px underline.
HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT rename any control id (btn-*, font-family, ...) or any data-cmd value: the geometry census (geom-wo.cjs), interaction census, and command dispatch depend on them. Removing/hiding controls fails the task even if the gate passes.
- Do NOT touch anything outside apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg (no packages/editor-common specs, no React ribbon, no other apps).
- Keep aria-labels, data-i18n attributes, roles, and the .menu-bar ribbon-tab markup intact.
- The wysiwyg app has no unit tests. The geometry gate (geom-diff.py) and the chrome pixel gate run after merge in the main checkout; the accept below proves syntax + the structural change only. Commit on the worktree branch with a conventional message. Do not run the docserver.

Worktree layout: you are at the monorepo root; paths above are relative to it. Read index.html around line 195-215 and style.css around lines 120-150 and 250-330 before editing.
